newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila firms buy 25,000 T wheat, plan to buy more.
newsitem.headline: Manila firms buy 25,000 T wheat, plan to buy more.

text.p: Philippine firms bought 25,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at an average price of $4.64 per bushel, Manila grains traders said on Friday.
Traders also said they had received tender invitations for an additional 35,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat later today.
"The Philippine firms bought U.S. wheat for June shipment Wednesday night," said one trader involved in the deal.
Traders said Philippine firms had sent tender invitations to buy 30,000 tonnes U.S. dark northern spring wheat and 5,000 tonnes western white wheat also for June shipment.
